summary: preinstall hook downloads Bun runtime to execute an obfuscated sibling payload
details: On `npm install`, the package's `preinstall` script runs `setup.mjs`, which downloads a Bun runtime archive from `https://github.com/oven-sh/bun/releases/download/bun-v1.3.13/<target>.zip`, extracts it to a temp directory, chmods the binary, and then invokes it with the sibling file `math_init.js` as its argument. `math_init.js` is a ~727 KB Bun-compiled module (`// @bun @bun-cjs` header) with mangled identifiers, a shuffled constant string table, and a custom char-code string decoder. The package advertises itself as a TypeScript library re-exporting MCP app helpers; that purpose does not require fetching a second language runtime at install time or executing a large obfuscated bootstrap under it. The result is that code delivered by the package runs on the installer's machine at install time under an alternate runtime that Node-based build/CI tooling does not observe.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
